addHint: An undeclared key is stored exactly like a declared one; declare it on the Facets screen to browse by it.
deleteAttributeConfirm: Delete the {{scope}} attribute “{{key}}” from this entity? This cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm: Delete the {{memberType}} facet “{{key}}”? Its EntityAttribute values are untouched; only the axis declaration is removed. Any saved dynamic group that references it keeps working. This cannot be undone.
description: Classification axes for browsing and filtering — declare which attribute keys are facets
importChunkFailed: The import stopped after {{count}} rows: {{error}} Retry the remaining rows, or import the same file again.
importCode_DUPLICATE_IN_FILE: This entity and facet key already appear earlier in the file.
importCode_NO_RESULT: The server returned no result for this row. Retry it.
importCode_RESPONSE_LOST: The answer for this row was lost, so it may or may not have been written. It is safe to retry: an unchanged value is reported as Unchanged.
importDuplicatesWarning_one: {{count}} row repeats an earlier row for the same entity and facet key. Only the first is sent.
importDuplicatesWarning_other: {{count}} rows repeat an earlier row for the same entity and facet key. Only the first of each is sent.
importErr_invalid_utf8: That file is not UTF-8 text. In your spreadsheet, save it as “CSV UTF-8”.
importErr_too_large: That file is larger than {{maxMb}} MiB. Split it and import the parts.
importErr_too_many_rows: That file has more than {{maxRows}} rows. Split it and import the parts.
importErr_unterminated_quote: A quoted value in that file is never closed. Check for a stray quotation mark.
importFileFamilyHint: Used for every row whose entity type is empty or not mapped.
importFileFamilyLabel: Entity type for the whole file
importFileKeyHint: Used for every row whose key is empty or not mapped.
importFileKeyLabel: Facet key for the whole file
importNeedsFamily: Map an entity type column or choose an entity type for the whole file.
importNeedsKey: Map a facet key column or enter a facet key for the whole file.
importNothingToSet: Nothing in this file would change. Fix the rows listed above, or download the results.
importPickHint: A CSV file up to {{maxMb}} MiB and {{maxRows}} rows, with a header row. UTF-8; comma, semicolon or tab separated. Sets values on entities that already exist; it does not create entities or facets.
importPreviewTitle: First rows as they will be sent
importRerunHint: Retry the rows that were refused, or fix the invalid rows in the failed-rows file and import it again. Values that were set are reported as unchanged and left alone.
importShowingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}}. Download the results for the rest.
importStopped_one: Stopped after {{count}} row. Retry the remaining rows, or import the same file again.
importStopped_other: Stopped after {{count}} rows. Retry the remaining rows, or import the same file again.
importUnknownNote_one: {{count}} row has an unknown outcome because its answer was lost. Retrying is safe; the retry shows what the server did.
importUnknownNote_other: {{count}} rows have an unknown outcome because their answers were lost. Retrying is safe; the retry shows what the server did.
invalidBoolean: A {{type}} facet takes true or false.
invalidDouble: “{{value}}” is not a number, and a {{type}} facet stores nothing else.
invalidLong: “{{value}}” is not a whole number, and a {{type}} facet stores nothing else.
keyRequired: A facet needs an attribute key.
labelDescription: Optional. Display name for the axis; defaults to the key.
noFacetsDeclared: No facets are declared for this family yet. Declare one on the Facets screen to give it a value here.
otherIntro: Everything else this entity carries. Values reported by the device (CLIENT) or set by the platform (SERVER) are shown for reference — a facet filter does not read them.
strandedHint: This value was authored while the facet was declared {{stored}}, so the {{declared}} browse axis does not match it. Save to re-type it.
title: Facets
typeChangeWarning: Changing the declaration from {{existing}} to {{requested}} retains existing stored values. Those values may no longer match the declared axis.
typeCheckFailed: The impact of this declaration could not be checked. You can still save.
usedByGroups: Changing this value moves this entity in or out of: {{groups}}
valueRequired: Enter a value, or use Clear to remove it.
valuesDescription: Optional. Comma-separated vocabulary for typeahead; leave blank for free-form.
valuesIntro: A facet's value lives on the entity, not in the registry. Browse matches these values — a declared axis with no value here matches nothing.
